title: Can You Spot a Deepfake? Not Always.
description:
Deepfakes are AI-made fake videos or audio. Some show glitches like odd blinking or lip sync, but better tools hide them. The safest check: who posted it, and are trusted outlets reporting it?

Sources:
• MIT Media Lab: Detect Fakes: https://www.media.mit.edu/projects/detect-fakes/overview/
• Britannica: Deepfake: https://www.britannica.com/technology/deepfake
